fr.intro: Une demande d'aide, une question, un sujet de prière, une idée de partenariat ? Écrivez-nous : chaque message est lu avec attention.

en.title: Contact us
en.intro: A request for help, a question, a prayer request, a partnership idea? Write to us: every message is read with care.
en.response: We usually reply within a few days [timeframe to confirm].
en.helpText: Write to us in confidence. Your request stays confidential. In an emergency, call 911; to find resources near you, call 211.
